deadline.value: Apply by January 1, 2027 for Fall enrollment.

gre_general.value: GRE General Test scores are required for all Computer Science PhD applicants and cannot be waived.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores must be received for each applicant, and cannot be waived.

also.quote: COMPUTER SCIENCE - PH.D. | Deadline for Fall Enrollment January 1 for fall enrollment | GRE General Requirement Yes

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Computer Science.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the department admissions page.

funding.value: Nearly all entering doctoral students receive five-year institutional fellowship packages.
funding.quote: Nearly all entering doctoral students in the humanities, social sciences, and sciences receive a five-year fellowship package. Every package includes tuition coverage, and many also include a stipend and health insurance.

also.quote: Every applicant to the Graduate Center's doctoral programs will automatically be considered for five-year institutional funding packages. The aid we offer — including fellowships, tuition awards, and assistantships — is based on merit.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is strongly recommended but not a formal prerequisite; applicants with a strong bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field may also apply.
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree is not a 'formal' prerequisite for admission but is strongly recommended. Applicants who do not have an MS or MA degree in Computer Science (or a related field) should demonstrate exceptional promise and sufficient background for entrance in their applications.
